---------
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---------
For the Petitioners: Mr. Prashant Pallav, Advocate Ms. Shivani Jaluka, Advocate For the State: Mr.
Praveen Akhouri, S.C.(Mines)-I Ms. Aishwarya Prakash, A.C. to S.C.(Mines)-I
---------
16/Dated: 12.08.2024
1.

Issue has been raised before this Court whether Annexure-10 and 11 which contain the notifications of the State Government are contrary to Section 26(3) of the new The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act or not.

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Another issue has been raised that the above notifications have been given retrospective effect which is not permissible in eyes of law.
2. Both the parties are directed to address on the above issues on the next date of listing.

3. List this case on 20.08.2024.
